content.page_summary: Reference list (citations 323-331) from a clinical guideline section on exercise training and rehabilitation in heart failure patients. Includes randomized trials, meta-analyses, systematic reviews, and trials comparing training intensities and effects on exercise capacity, quality of life, mortality, and hospitalization.
